notes: Site: Shopify storefront myborosil.com. Tier-1 direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no block encountered. Checked: full collections.json listing (393 published collections across 2 pages) for any handle/title containing clearance, outlet, final, last-chance, end-of-line, discontinued -- zero matches. Checked homepage header mega-menu and shop-by-category chip carousel (126 links) -- no clearance/outlet entry. Checked the site's own predictive search (/search/suggest.json) for queries 'clearance' and 'outlet' -- both returned zero collection/page results. Queried 'sale' and found only generic/seasonal promotional listings: Borosil Sale, Borosil Sale Larah, Flash Sale, Employees Sale, Winter Sale, Christmas Sale, Diwali Sale, New Year Sale, Black Friday Sale, and End Of Year Sale (handle eoys1/end-of-year-sale) -- opened /collections/borosil-sale directly; its own H1 reads simply 'Borosil Sale' with no outlet/permanent-markdown/end-of-line language anywhere on the page or in the collection title/description. None of these use Clearance/Outlet/Final Sale/Last Chance/End of Line/Discontinued wording or any on-page copy describing permanent markdown or discontinued/outlet stock -- per the brief's Clearance-vs-Sale test, these are generic or campaign-tied seasonal promotions (Christmas, Diwali, Winter, New Year, Black Friday, an internal 'Employees Sale', and an end-of-fiscal-year sale), not clearance-style merchandising, so none were recorded as ambiguous Clearance candidates. Conclusion: after real investigation of navigation, the full collection list, and site search, Borosil (myborosil.com) has no genuine Clearance/Outlet-type PLP.
